**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Meridian Fieldworks:

- **§ 12.3** expressly records that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment" — a helpful affirmative disclaimer in our favour.
- **§ 7.1** binds Customer only to pay the Order Form Fees and constrains *Vendor* from adding unidentified charges.
- **§ 8.3** caps *Vendor's* renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

Full-text searches for "most-favoured", "favourable/favorable", "no less favourable", "best price", "benchmark", and third-party matching language surfaced nothing beyond § 12.3. Nothing requires us to extend Copperleaf terms given to third parties or to match competing offers, so the preferred position is already met and no edit is warranted.

Note for the wider review (outside this rule): §§ 2.1 (take-or-pay minimum), 2.2 (sole and exclusive provider) and 12.4 (24-month non-compete on Customer) sit awkwardly against § 12.3's disclaimer and should be picked up under the exclusivity/non-compete and volume-commitment rules.
